03d1ea893954d49b68ca0765c93a43638c47668da0677641916fb037ec97b7e6 {"baseline_commit":"42c30799fcea8a00fc9c9fa2d796eccb11f3759b","basis":"Additive change with no behaviour change for this record: accept_claim_expecting, bind_retained_claim, RetainedClaimIdentity, AcceptanceReport::accepts_as_bound_claim and the claim-slot constructors were added; AcceptanceReport gained a claim_bound field that is false unless a claim is bound (accepts_as_claim is unchanged); accept_claim, now deprecated, delegates to the shared accept with no retained identity and behaves as in 3.0; re-export lists gained the new names and the deprecated accept_claim moved to its own allowed re-export.
